title: Fixed Separated Vessel Negative Mould Halves
description: One newly authored complete separated two-part ceramic-casting-mould exterior, counted as one set rather than two repeated new models. Each whole thick rectangular half contains one genuinely concave half-round bottle-shaped negative cavity: a tapered closed lower end, broad body, changing shoulder, narrow neck and an open exit through the upper end wall. All material walls, parting faces and bottom remain one closed shared-vertex mesh per half. Two complete locating-pin exteriors on one half correspond visually to two real blind locator cups on the other. Both whole parts are laid face-up with a positive gap, not shown assembled or operating. This differs from the old one-sided shallow scalloped food mould and raised die on a handle, and from a freestanding amphora: there is no vessel wall or imported jar split into pieces, only newly authored negative body boundaries inside full support blocks. Two opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up, full horizontal bounds centred and both complete undersides grounded. One whole craft prop zero scenes. Generic static mould-inspired art only: no slip, liquid, casting, draft/release validation, shrinkage, assembly fit, absorbency, material authenticity, production dimensions, manufacture or safety claim. No rigging, animation or interaction.
